name: CBR
title: CBR / NEUROCOVID
description: Chemobrain cohort: longitudinal structural MRI (Siemens Skyra 3T), with SWI, clinical DWI and, in some exams, multi-TI PASL.
sessions_note: Visit index from the exam folder suffix: CBR-003 -> ses-1 (baseline), CBR-003.2 -> ses-2 (6 months), CBR-003.3 -> ses-3 (12 months).
acquisition_note: Facts about this protocol, verified in its DICOMs: multi-TI 3D PASL without an M0 series, and a gre_field_mapping that exported the phase image only. make_derivatives.py writes them into the ASL / field-map scaffolds; a study that does not declare them gets REQUIRED_FILL_ME for the researcher.
steps_note: Defacing ON, as a sharing copy only (decided 11/nov/2026). FreeSurfer, SAMSEG and every analysis read the original bids/sub-*; deface writes a separate bids/derivatives/defaced/ that no step reads, kept for external sharing. The advisor had advised against defacing; it stays on because nothing is analysed on the defaced images (confirm with the advisor before sharing). FreeSurfer outputs (orig.mgz, rawavg.mgz, T1.mgz, nu.mgz) still show the face.
